about: The collecta of the formulary “Low Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who have completed the Paschal feasts may, by Thy bounty, retain them in our conduct and life. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
